baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction joins the verbal noun إطعام to a severe hunger-event through في يوم ذي مسغبة.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nourishment crosses from a possessor to another person exactly when hunger has become exhausting and socially extensive; timing under scarcity, not food in the abstract, gives the act its force.

activation_trace.role: Giving food to another anchors an outward transfer rather than the feeder's own eating.
The severe event-day makes the transfer a response to an acute occasion.
Hunger with exhaustion and famine supplies the recipient's bodily and collective emergency.

changed_reading.after: Move nourishment outward precisely when famine makes both the need and the cost of giving acute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إطعام, يوم, and مسغبة can be read as provision sustained across a duration of famine.
baseline_models.mechanism: The provision/livelihood branch and the open-span branch stretch the act beyond one plate: feeding maintains another's viable condition through an interval in which hunger repeatedly returns.

activation_trace.role: Provision and livelihood widen feeding from a meal to material maintenance.
An open span of time lets the hungry period exceed a single daylight interval.
Famine and exhausted hunger make maintenance recurrent rather than episodic.

changed_reading.after: Keep another person provisioned across the duration of an exhausting scarcity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ability branch of ط ع م remains attached to إطعام and meets the exhaustion named by مسغبة.
baseline_models.mechanism: Food intake interrupts hunger's depletion and returns capacity for motion, judgment, and action; the relevant outcome is not merely possession of calories but restored agency.

activation_trace.role: The ability branch supplies restored capability as feeding's functional result.
Taking in nourishment supplies the bodily means by which capability can return.
Hunger joined to exhaustion identifies the incapacity that nourishment reverses.

changed_reading.after: Restore a hunger-exhausted person's power to act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The grafting and receptive-insertion branch belongs to the focus root ط ع م itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: Feeding is imagined as introducing support into a stressed living system so that the support is received and becomes operative, not merely placing an object beside a need.

activation_trace.role: A graft that accepts an insertion supplies the image of aid entering and taking hold.
The severe occasion supplies the stressed environment in which successful uptake matters.
Famine supplies the damaged condition into which sustaining support must take.

changed_reading.after: Introduce sustenance in a form the famine-stressed recipient can actually receive and incorporate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Division into shares, a bounded inhabited place, and an obligation coming due turn famine feeding into reallocation inside a shared civic container: stored livelihood crosses an internal boundary toward the person whose share of survival has failed.

activation_trace.role: Provision and livelihood supply the material that can be redistributed.
Separating a thing into shares supplies the distributive operation.
A bounded place supplies the common spatial container across which provision moves.
An obligation becoming due makes redistribution answerable rather than optional.

structural_cues: 90:1-2 repeats the same البلد around the resident addressee, while 90:14 places feeding inside a second bounded frame, في يوم.
The focus nominalization leaves the distributor unstated, allowing a civic rather than exclusively private agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shares, a bounded place, due obligation, and livelihood; I infer that scarcity makes inhabitants' holdings mutually answerable. A live alternative is that oath and city frame only intensify rhetoric without specifying redistribution.

changed_reading.before: A private donor gives food during famine.
changed_reading.after: A bounded community's provision is reapportioned when a member's survival-share collapses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generation produces vulnerable life into hardship, while the focus branch of continuous formation makes feeding the maintenance bridge by which created life continues after its initial coming-to-be.

activation_trace.role: Continuous formation makes nourishment part of keeping a living form ongoing.
Famine supplies the interruption that threatens life's continuation.
Something generated from another supplies intergenerational dependence and succession.
Bringing creation into being supplies the life whose continuation requires maintenance.
Hardship and struggle supply the resistant condition through which life must be carried.

structural_cues: Parent and offspring in 90:3 are followed by human creation in hardship in 90:4, before the focus later names nourishment under hunger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generation, creation, continuous formation, and hardship; I infer a causal bridge in which feeding maintains what generation begins. The alternative is that the creation sequence states a general human condition without a maintenance claim.

changed_reading.after: Carry generated human life forward through the hardship that threatens its continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence opposes a speaker's counted claim of exhausting piled wealth to capacity and visibility. The focus supplies a bodily audit: expenditure counts as feeding when an exhausted other visibly regains ability, not when the spender merely names a large amount.

activation_trace.role: Ability supplies the recipient-side outcome by which expenditure can be tested.
Exhausted hunger supplies the deficit whose reversal would be bodily evidence.
Counting and accounting supply the evaluative ledger.
Effective power supplies the contrast between claimed spending and produced capability.
Spoken utterance marks the wealth expenditure first as a claim.
Exhausting effort or resources supplies the claimant's asserted depletion.
Accumulated wealth supplies the stock from which a transfer could have been made.
A piled, overlapping mass supplies the boast's image of magnitude.
Sight and insight demand evidence beyond the spender's self-report.

structural_cues: The repeated أَيَحْسَبُ questions in 90:5 and 90:7 enclose the first-person wealth claim of 90:6.
Capacity appears before the claim, visibility after it, and the focus later supplies a recipient-facing act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting, power, speech, depleted piled wealth, sight, and restored ability; I infer that the recipient's changed condition audits the spender's claim. A live alternative is narrower: the questions expose arrogance without proposing an outcome metric.

changed_reading.before: Feeding is one expenditure among other expenditures.
changed_reading.after: Feeding is expenditure made verifiable by the hungry person's restored capacity, displacing the donor's boast as the unit of account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Careful sight detects need, tongue and lips transmit it, and guidance directs a response; feeding becomes the completion of a perception-communication-action circuit rather than an unprompted object transfer.

activation_trace.role: Feeding another supplies the circuit's material response.
The eye of care and oversight supplies active recognition of another's condition.
Conveying a message supplies transmission of need or responsibility.
Speech passing from lip to lip makes recognition socially relayed rather than private.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the move from awareness to chosen response.

structural_cues: 90:8-10 lists paired organs and guidance immediately before the obstacle sequence.
The focus leaves the hungry recipient grammatically implicit until 90:15-16, so recognition and communication can mediate the connection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies organs of care, message transmission, lip-to-lip speech, guidance, and feeding; I supply the directional sequence notice-to-report-to-response. The live alternative is that the organs only establish general moral equipment.

changed_reading.before: A giver notices hunger and gives food.
changed_reading.after: Feeding completes a social sensing circuit in which need is seen, voiced, relayed, and answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance identifies an elevated, effortful route; entry into danger and the hard ascent make famine feeding a mode of crossing the obstacle. Its difficulty is endogenous: on a scarcity-day the giver enters the same constricted field rather than acting from frictionless surplus.

activation_trace.role: Feeding another supplies the concrete crossing-practice.
A severe event-day makes the practice costly rather than routine.
Famine supplies the resistant terrain through which provision must move.
Direction toward a path supplies orientation before the difficult entry.
Hardship and distress make the indicated route an effort-bearing elevation.
Perils and road difficulties supply the forceful entry into resistance.
The hard rising pass supplies the obstacle's spatial mechanics.
Knowledge identifies the following acts as disclosure of what the obstacle practically is.

structural_cues: 90:11 names failure to enter the obstacle, 90:12 asks what discloses it, and 90:13-16 answer with nominal acts and recipients.
The focus's أو coordinates feeding with release while preserving a distinct crossing mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path-guidance, hardship, perilous entry, a steep pass, knowledge, and famine feeding; I infer that the answer-list consists of crossing practices. The alternative is a non-spatial list of virtues attached rhetorically to the obstacle.

changed_reading.before: Feeding during crisis is a commendable option.
changed_reading.after: Feeding into scarcity is itself the difficult motion by which the agent enters and crosses the pass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root unexpectedly contains a throat-gripping image, while the immediately prior act opens confinement and releases a neck. Their adjacency permits a reversal model: famine constricts the intake passage like a grip, and feeding releases that metabolic captivity.

activation_trace.role: Gripping and squeezing the throat supplies the bodily image of constriction that feeding reverses.
Exhausting hunger supplies the metabolic force behaving like a grip.
Releasing a pledge or neck from confinement supplies the counter-motion of opening.
The literal neck locates legal release and metabolic constriction at one bodily threshold.

structural_cues: 90:13 and 90:14 are adjacent nominal alternatives under the single obstacle explanation.
The neck and the food-passage create a bodily hinge between legal and metabolic forms of captivity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, neck, throat-grip, and famine; I infer hunger as the gripping force and feeding as reversal even though the focus branch literally names the grip. The live alternative is a simple pairing of emancipation and almsgiving with no shared bodily mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Freeing a neck and feeding are two unrelated good deeds.
changed_reading.after: They coexist as releases from two constraints, with feeding loosening famine's grip at the throat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named recipients occupy two breaks in support topology: a child cut off from a caregiver but near in kinship, and a person immobilized and humiliated by poverty. Feeding functions like a graft that reconnects the severed dependent and gives the grounded person material traction.

activation_trace.role: A graft accepting connection supplies the repair of a broken care relation.
Actual feeding keeps the network image materially anchored in food given to another.
A child cut off from a caregiver supplies the severed support node.
Kinship proximity supplies the available edge across which care should reconnect.
The humiliation of destitution supplies social as well as caloric depletion.
Poverty figured as sticking to earth supplies immobilization at the lowest material level.

structural_cues: 90:15-16 grammatically fill in the recipients left implicit by 90:14 and distinguish relation-loss from condition-loss.
ذا مقربة and ذا متربة make proximity and grounded poverty functional qualifiers, not interchangeable labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caregiver-severance, kinship, humiliation, ground-stuck poverty, and a receptive graft; I infer feeding as repair of support connectivity and material traction. The alternative is that the recipient labels only rank deserving cases.

changed_reading.before: Deliver food to two especially needy categories.
changed_reading.after: Use nourishment to reconnect a severed care relation and lift a person whom poverty has pinned to the ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from crisis acts to becoming part of a mutually exhorting body. Feeding is not exhausted in a donor-recipient instant: it helps form a community that repeatedly connects counsel, bears responsibility, and treats need with kin-like tenderness.

activation_trace.role: Continuous formation supplies feeding's extension into a durable social practice.
Livelihood keeps collective formation tied to recurring material provision.
Standing over and caring for another supplies sustained responsibility.
Security and trusting stillness supply the condition produced by reliable care.
Mutual exchange of counsel supplies reciprocal reinforcement rather than unilateral giving.
Bearing a guarantee and staying with it supplies durability across repeated need.
Womb-kinship supplies a model of belonging that expands care beyond one transaction.

structural_cues: ثم كان in 90:17 places communal becoming after, but not apart from, the crisis acts.
The repeated تواصوا makes the later relation explicitly reciprocal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuing formation, livelihood, care, security, reciprocal counsel, durable responsibility, and kinship; I infer that feeding helps constitute the group that sustains it. A live alternative is a strict sequence in which belief and counsel are separate qualifications added after the act.

changed_reading.before: One capable person sustains one needy person.
changed_reading.after: Crisis feeding helps form a reciprocal community that keeps provision, patience, and mercy in circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Companionship and blessing on one side oppose covered blessing and denied visible signs on the other. Feeding makes provision socially manifest: a hidden or privately enclosed good becomes an observable relation of accompaniment.

activation_trace.role: Provision and good condition supply the blessing whose social visibility is at stake.
Companionship and abiding together turn provision into a maintained relation.
Blessing supplies the positive value that feeding discloses and circulates.
Covering a blessing supplies the contrary operation of withholding its acknowledgment or use.
A manifest sign supplies public legibility against concealment.

structural_cues: 90:18-19 classify two companion-groups only after the embodied acts and reciprocal practices.
The contrast between ميمنة and مشأمة is relationally plural, not an isolated donor score.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, companionship, blessing, covering, and a visible sign; I infer that feeding uncovers blessing by making it operative between people. The alternative is that the final classification concerns belief alone and does not retrospectively redescribe provision.

changed_reading.before: Spend part of one's provision on another.
changed_reading.after: Uncover provision as a visible, companion-forming blessing instead of leaving it socially covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final fire is closed over its occupants, and a non-dominant branch of the closing root images a stone store for wealth in a mountain. Against that terminal enclosure, feeding is an outward opening of livelihood: stock leaves its protected container before enclosure becomes the governing social form.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood and provision supply the stock capable of being opened toward another.
Kindled fire supplies the destructive content of the terminal enclosure.
Closing tightly over something supplies the final anti-circulation state.
A stone mountain-store for wealth supplies the surprising material image of protected stock.

structural_cues: The focus sends nourishment outward, whereas the final عليهم نار مؤصدة encloses content and occupants together.
The split mapping of و ص د preserves both generic closure and a wealth-storage image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, fire, tight closure, and a stone wealth-store; I infer a reversal between circulating sustenance and sealed stock. The live alternative is that final closure is solely punitive imagery with no retrospective economics.

changed_reading.after: Break the closure around stored livelihood so provision can circulate before sealed possession becomes a destructive enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر و ي mapping carried by the context root ر ء ي. It remains anchored because the focus food branch explicitly includes nourishing drink and the focus names exhausted hunger; downstream prose should present it as a split-root resonance, not as the lexical meaning of يره.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's intake branch includes drink when tasted or nourishing, so quenching can register feeding in the recipient's body.

activation_trace.role: Taking in food or nourishing drink anchors satiation and quenching in the focus act.
Exhausted hunger supplies the bodily deficit that successful nourishment changes.
The non-dominant mapped image of quenching thirst recasts visibility as an embodied result.

changed_reading.before: Whether spending was seen is a question of surveillance.
changed_reading.after: A transfer becomes 'seen' in an exploratory bodily sense when the recipient is no longer hungry or unquenched.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because the smallness image comes from the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping of a context occurrence of ق و ل. It stays anchored through the focus's famine-timed feeding and the adjacent piled-wealth image; downstream prose should mark it as a scale-correction resonance, not a morphology claim about يقول.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus measures provision against a famine-scale need, so donor-side magnitude can be relativized by recipient-side insufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Feeding another anchors the relevant scale in what reaches the needy person.
A severe event-day enlarges the need against which an amount must be judged.
The non-dominant smallness image destabilizes the speaker's donor-side magnitude claim.
Piled abundance supplies the apparent magnitude that famine-scale need can expose as insufficient.

changed_reading.before: A piled amount spent is necessarily a large moral transfer.
changed_reading.after: What sounds piled on the giver's ledger may remain small when measured by nourishment actually reaching famine.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because it links ripening, a fruit-cover, blossom, and close-rooted plants across distant branches. It remains focus-anchored in the ط ع م ripening branch and the named famine; downstream prose should render it only as an ecological production analogy, never as a replacement gloss for إطعام.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus food root includes fruit reaching maturity and taking flavor, allowing famine feeding to expose the production phase before edible provision.

activation_trace.role: Fruit ripening and taking flavor anchors edible provision in a maturation process.
Famine supplies the system-level failure of edible provision to arrive.
A fruit-cover supplies enclosure around produce before availability.
Tree blossom supplies an earlier generative phase in the food chain.
Closely rooted plants supply the ecological substrate whose yield must become edible.

changed_reading.before: Feeding begins when prepared food changes hands.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, famine feeding also implicates whether rooted growth, blossom, covered fruit, and ripening are brought through to edible availability.

strongest_changes: Feeding became the recipient's embodied audit of claimed expenditure: restored capacity matters more than the donor's announced amount.
The obstacle sequence turned feeding under scarcity into the difficult motion of crossing, not merely a virtue placed beside the pass.
The named recipients changed feeding into repair of a severed or immobilized care network.
The later reciprocal sequence extended one crisis transfer into a durable community of provision, responsibility, and mercy.
The neck-release adjacency kept alive an exploratory reversal in which feeding loosens famine's bodily grip.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported several simultaneous scales: acute transfer, duration-long maintenance, restoration of agency, receptive grafting, civic redistribution, network repair, and communal formation. Split mappings added contained but productive surprises around quenching, apparent smallness, stored wealth, and ecological maturation.
remaining_uncertainties: يوم can remain an acute severe occasion or widen into a longer famine-span; neither temporal scale eliminates the other.
The civic-share, recipient-outcome audit, and sealed-store models require reader-supplied directional arrows even though every component is packet-backed.
The throat-release, split-root, and ecological readings are mechanistically coherent but should remain explicitly exploratory rather than become lexical paraphrases.
The sequence after ثم may make community a consequence of the acts, an added qualification on their agent, or both.
